children: PancakeSwap is offering a limited-time subscription portal, with a third-party service provider arranging the underlying tokenized exposure. According to Odaily, eligible users can subscribe through self-custody wallets after completing a qualification check and accepting the relevant terms, while keeping control of their assets.

Each activity page will disclose company and token information, the subscription asset, issuance price, implied valuation, event timing, claim arrangements, and risk disclosures. After the event ends, participants will enter the claim or refund process according to the specific rules.

title: PancakeSwap Launches Limited-Time Subscription Portal for Tokenized Exposure
